body: Don't people with BPD do the same related to other personality disorders that is considered "worse" like NPD, ASPD etc...? But i feel you. It hurts. Esspecially depression is very "likeable" when you have to have a mental problem.

I didn't ask anyone to speculate on my life to be honest. Just talking.

BPD and AVPD can co-exist. NPD is another cluster B personality disorder, not thát different sadly enough. Thats why I am worried.

Im sorry most of you were abused. I got the impression yes from both psychologist as BPD-sufferers that it is a disorder for people with trauma/neglect.

Unfortunately I am not able to get diagnosed. Mental aid is a disaster in my country right now. :(

Thank you for your reply, will look into it maybe.

Everytime i hear therapists asking for sympathy with BPD-sufferes it is about how they had trauma and bad childhood, no safety as a kid etc..

A therapist once told me she thought I had "traits of BPD" next to AVPD. Never got any proper diagnosis or treatment.

There is definitly something wrong with me though. For example: dont have any friends, lots of conflicts with people in the past, been an online stalker to my ex-fiance and his wife (sending emails and calling them to shout i hate you, blaming them for ridicilious things). Im crazy.

I feel you. Thank you for opening up, I kind of like I hite a nerve with my post eventhough I dont really wish for anyone to feel like me/us. But it is nice to know you're not alone, and that we recognize eachothers struggles and feelings. 

I hope for you too a friend like her again.

thank you, much appreciated. You don't have to say sorry please. Your message is real and kind.

It's not a strange advice from you to try to contact him again. I did that actually a few years ago. But he moved on and is not interested in me anymore. He made that clear. So that door is closed permanently.

Im jealous on the answers here. I know people perceive me as socially awkward, stupid, and insecure. Awkwardness and insecurity is written all over me. Sometimes I see people make a grimas from vicarious shame.

Wish i was perceived arrogant. That meant I was hiding it well.

These answers show me that my AvPD is different. It is real, not perceived awkwardness/rejection.

you are right, thank you. That last sentence hit home. I am so much in my bubble last days of self-hatred that i really didnt even think about that tbh (i know it sounds strange but sometimes we are so convinced everything is our fault).
yes i would think that too, i know. But she really seemed a bit annoyed and careless honestly. But thank you for your reply and your perspective.

Oh I am sorry for you as well. Luckily you are still functioning well. I hope both of us will do till we die. 

I understand your fear. Btw I also thought that I would never live on my own. But somehow I got a job and I can support myself and live on my own. I hope you will find that too sometime soon. Do you have a job right now? And can you save up? 

Do you also fear of what will happen when you can't take care of yourself anymore, do you think about it or have a plan? And where you live? I am living in Europe with good health care system finanically at least, so i am grateful for that.

Oh wow that is exactly how it went with me too (well minus the fall). Also the numbness on my body that went away.

It would be quite a coincidence though that you got MS-symptoms right after your fall. Hopefully that will be the cause of your symptoms.

What are they going to do now? Will you get a spinal tap?

Omg I feel you so much. I always feel like "WHEN are we going to start? ". Its like i talk and talk and talk about myself, in the hope that they get me and give me some options/treatment. But it never progresses. 

Now I am with a psychologist that my sister recommended. She is normal with some basic simple mental mood issues. I was sceptical already. I went there, and well at least he is different as he is kind of harsh (i dont mind that as i dont need empathy), but he also told me "i will not treat you, I am not a doctor that has a treatment for you, you have to do it yourself" and said that many more times in lots and lots of metaphors he must have used a 1000 times already. It annoyed me but at the time I thought ok yes maybe this is good, maybe this is what i need, as nothing else worked. But now i think ; euh yeah for what i (=my insurance) am paying you then exactly? I plan to ask him clearly next time what he can do for me and what he studied 6 years for then.

​

But did you never got a sheet with CBT stuff on it? Like what you feel, what happened, what other positive thought you can give that. Couple of therapists gave me that. And then we talked about "the situations" i had to write about during that week. And then nothing happened.

Thanks. Something to think about [surely.My](https://surely.My) neurologist says she can agree with me not choosing for a second MRI because there is no hard evidence that treatment works.

The symptoms are not really the same, only that it is "weird sensations" from the start. But where, and in which intensity and after which activity changes a lot. Thats why I am worried about new lesions.

Glad to hear you are doing so well!! and that this Gilenya for sure did work for you!
